result.brief: 提出正交 JEPA，通过正交预测分解将目标状态拆分为多分量并由共享上下文分别预测，缓解单一嵌入的容量冗余与梯度冲突，提升潜世界模型的表征质量与长时预测稳定性。
result.reason: Introduces Orthogonal JEPA, a factorized latent world-model representation learning method with orthogonal predictive factorization, directly advancing JEPA-style self-supervised visual/video representation learning.
